title: Abst-GP V5.5 Disaster Recovery Formal Certification Plan

gates.name: PostgreSQL Base Backup (pg_basebackup) & Physical Recovery
gates.scenario: Scenario A: Full PostgreSQL Loss and Physical Base Backup Restoration
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_scenario_a_full_postgresql_recovery or test_7_4_a'
gates.pass_criteria: pg_basebackup plain directory backup with sha256 checksums, verified via pg_verifybackup, fail-closed without pg_dump fallback, restored to clean cluster with 100% table and row consistency.

gates.name: Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) & Continuous WAL Replay
gates.scenario: Scenario B: Accidental Logical Deletion PITR Drill
gates.command: docker cp verification/dr/run_pitr_drill.sh verification-db-dr-1:/tmp/run_pitr_drill.sh; docker exec -u postgres verification-db-dr-1 sh /tmp/run_pitr_drill.sh
gates.pass_criteria: Physical base backup + WAL replay from /var/lib/postgresql/archive to exact recovery target timestamp/LSN, automatic promotion to Timeline 2, baseline T0 and target T2 transactions restored, post-target T3 corruption excluded.

gates.name: Corrupted Backup Rejection & Fail-Closed Integrity
gates.scenario: Scenario C: Tampered Manifest and Corrupted Segment Rejection
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_scenario_c_corrupted_backup_rejection or test_7_4_a_failure_of_pg_verifybackup'
gates.pass_criteria: Immediate rejection on tampered SHA256 checksums or HMAC signature mismatch, fail-closed execution, SRE critical alert fired and logged in AuditLog.

gates.name: Redis Loss & Clean Rebuild from PostgreSQL SSOT
gates.scenario: Scenario D: Complete Redis Ephemeral State Loss and Rebuild
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_scenario_d_lost_redis_rebuild'
gates.pass_criteria: Redis FLUSHALL simulated loss, PostgreSQL SSOT untouched, clean rebuild of Redis key namespaces, zero duplicate job re-executions for READY/FAILED_FINAL states.

gates.name: Dead Worker Reconciliation & Safe Exponential Retry
gates.scenario: Scenario E: Worker Crash During PROCESSING and Stale Heartbeat Recovery
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_scenario_e_dead_worker_reconciliation'
gates.pass_criteria: Orphaned PROCESSING jobs with expired heartbeat identified, returned to QUEUED with attempt_count incremented and failure_classification=RETRYABLE.

gates.name: Missing Document Detection & Inconsistency Alerting
gates.scenario: Scenario F: Storage Inconsistency and Missing Physical File Detection
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_scenario_f_missing_document_detection'
gates.pass_criteria: Unresolved documents in database lacking filesystem files detected with status=FAIL, specific document IDs cataloged, valid restore returns status=PASS.

gates.name: Multi-Tenant Isolation & SRE Contract Enforcement
gates.scenario: Scenario G: Cross-Tenant Isolation Boundaries under DR and SRE Telemetry Contracts
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_scenario_g_monitoring_and_sre_contracts or test_dr_telemetry'
gates.pass_criteria: Tenant A is strictly isolated from Tenant B data/documents/jobs/alerts during and after DR restoration, SRE telemetry metrics enforce non-null and typed contracts.

gates.name: Recovery Point Objective (RPO <= 5 min)
gates.scenario: Scenario H: Quantitative RPO Measurement from Incident Timestamp
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_dr_rpo_rto_quantitative_measurement'
gates.pass_criteria: Effective RPO = MAX(PostgreSQL RPO, Document RPO) <= 300 seconds.

gates.name: Recovery Time Objective (RTO <= 15 min)
gates.scenario: Scenario I: End-to-End Recovery Stopwatch from Disaster to Pipeline Readiness
gates.command: docker compose -p abst_gp_dr_certification -f verification/docker-compose.dr.yml run --rm backend-dr pytest tests/dr/test_disaster_recovery.py -k 'test_dr_rpo_rto_quantitative_measurement'
gates.pass_criteria: Total RTO from disaster declaration to full E2E document processing operational readiness <= 900 seconds.
